card.text: Five galaxies close together on the sky: four are a true group, and the fifth is far in front.

sources.label: ESA/Webb weic2208a: NASA, ESA, CSA, and STScI
sources.locator: caption: only four of the galaxies are truly close together; the fifth and leftmost galaxy, NGC 7320, is well in the foreground compared with the other four

introduction.text: Webb's infrared view of the group. The leftmost galaxy, NGC 7320, is much nearer than the other four; the picture is flat and has no depth.

sources.label: ESA/Webb weic2208a: NASA, ESA, CSA, and STScI
sources.locator: Stephan's Quintet (NIRCam + MIRI Imaging); Webb NIRCam and MIRI, from 0.9 to 7.7 µm: near-infrared blue to orange, mid-infrared yellow and red

optical.title: Stephan's Quintet in infrared
optical.summary: Webb's near- and mid-infrared image of the five galaxies. A flat picture of the sky, with no depth.
